items.title: Disney Adds Formula E to Disney+: Can Live Sports Strengthen its Streaming Business?
items.summary: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has secured a multi-year agreement to stream the all-electric Formula E World Championship across 144 territories, expanding the live-sports offering available through Disney+. Beginning with the 2026–27 season, subscribers will receive live coverage of practice sessions, qualifying sessions, and races, as well as replays, analysis, and behind-the-scenes programming.
